body.description: Fields to change on the customer.

schema.description: Fields accepted when updating a customer. Read-only: `Id`, `IdBusiness`, `IdSegment`, the creation and update stamps, and `Links`. `Status` is read-only and derived from `StateCustomer` — set `StateCustomer`, not `Status`.

StateCustomer.description:
Granular technical state of a customer.

* `Enabled` — customer is active (`Status` = `Enabled`)
* `Suspended` — customer has been suspended (`Status` = `Suspended`)
StateCustomer.title: StateCustomer

Metadata.description: Set of key/value pairs attached to the object, up to five keys. Writable at creation and on every update of the parent object. On an update, send a key with an empty value to unset that key, or send an empty value for `Metadata` to clear every key.
Metadata.title: Metadata
